CREATE VIEW container_depletion_rank_view AS
SELECT 
    c.containregistry,
    c.containmodel,
    c.volliters,
    c.masskg,
    c.coolkind,
    c.coolremainpct,
    c.refilllatest,
    ROUND(CAST((100 - c.coolremainpct) / (CURRENT_DATE - c.refilllatest) AS numeric), 4) AS coolant_depletion_rate,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (100 - c.coolremainpct) / (CURRENT_DATE - c.refilllatest) DESC) AS depletion_rank,
    CASE

        WHEN (100 - c.coolremainpct) / (CURRENT_DATE - c.refilllatest) > 0.04 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS depletion_status
FROM container c;
